description: AICTIONBOT™ invoice writer by KULIC Advisory (tool 52). Takes seller, buyer, invoice number and dates, payment terms and lines (description, quantity, UN/ECE unit code, net unit price, VAT rate or category) and returns a structured e-invoice as UN/CEFACT Cross Industry Invoice XML: ZUGFeRD/Factur-X profile EN 16931 or XRechnung 3.0 for German public authorities (Leitweg-ID as buyer_reference). Calculates in cents (line amounts, VAT per category and rate, totals), checks the mandatory details of section 14 (4) UStG, the EN 16931 business rules and the German XRechnung rules (BR-DE: contact, phone, e-mail, IBAN, buyer reference), validates IBAN check digits and VAT ID format, and handles small business (section 19 UStG), reverse charge (section 13b UStG), intra-community supply and export with the exemption reason. Red findings block the XML, yellow ones are notes. The Workbench page https://www.kulicadvisory.com/workbench/write-invoice/ turns the same data into a PDF/A-3 with the XML embedded. Generated invoices passed XSD, the official EN 16931 and KoSIT XRechnung schematron and veraPDF. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Not tax advice. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

buyer.description: name, street, postcode, city, country, vat_id, email

buyer_reference.description: Buyer reference; for XRechnung to authorities the Leitweg-ID (required for xrechnung)

delivery_date.description: Delivery or service date (or use period_start and period_end)

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

lines.description: Rows: description, quantity, unit (C62 piece, HUR hour, DAY, MON, KGM, MTR, MTK, LTR, KMT, LS lump sum, SET), unit_price (net), vat_rate (19, 7), category (standard, small_business, reverse_charge, intra_community, export, not_taxable).

payment_terms.description: Payment terms text, for example "Payable within 14 days without deduction."

profile.description: zugferd (default, EN 16931) or xrechnung (XRechnung 3.0, for public authorities)

seller.description: name, street, postcode, city, country (ISO code, default DE), vat_id, tax_number, register, email, phone, contact, iban, bic, account_holder

name: create_einvoice
title: Write an invoice: German e-invoice as ZUGFeRD/Factur-X EN 16931 or XRechnung 3.0 (CII XML), with the mandatory details checked under section 14 UStG
